shared_elements: upright slab/pillar carved in low relief
repeated row of similar motifs across a horizontal band
schematic small figures with heads and limbs
justification: Both are tall upright slabs carved in low relief with content organised into stacked horizontal registers, and both include a row of repeated similar units along a band near the top. However, A depicts recognisable animals (bird-headed and quadruped creatures, a large long-necked bird, a snake-like/scorpion form) in an open, sparsely filled field, while B is filled edge-to-edge with dense columns of small rectangular cartouche-like sign blocks; the specific motifs, their relationships, and the outline/infill conventions have essentially nothing distinctive in common.
